verified: OpenAI's own announcement page and third-party model trackers confirm that GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol were released in November 2026 with a context window of roughly 1.05 million tokens and API pricing of $8 per million input tokens, $0.40 per million cached input tokens and $40 per million output tokens for Astra, and $2/$10 for Sol; GeekPark reports the rollout on 18 November, Beijing time, and the models are being offered through ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API rather than the standard ChatGPT chat interface.
unconfirmed: the headline benchmark placements and per-task cost figures come from Artificial Analysis and Epoch AI indices as cited by GeekPark, not from an independent test run for this briefing; the negative developer verdicts (Matt Shumer, Theo Browne, Ethan Mollick, Simon Willison, Dan Shipper) are individual first-hand impressions; the claim that GPT-6.1 Astra was cancelled at the last minute, the ~25% engineer reassignment and the reported safety-regression numbers rest on OpenAI's system card and GeekPark's reporting; the claim that California's attorney general sued OpenAI over at least 80 safety incidents one day before launch is an allegation reported by GeekPark and has not been confirmed against a court filing here; and the fast-mode price increase scheduled for 1 March 2027, the hallucination-rate comparisons and the 59% figure for Astra are unverified outside the outlets GeekPark cites. The article text also cuts off mid-sentence at its end.

verified: OpenAI 官方发布页显示，GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 于 2026 年 11 月上线（极客公园称北京时间为 11 月 18 日凌晨，第三方页面记为 11 月 17 日），主打更强的专业输出、编程与电脑操作能力及更低成本；Astra 定价为每百万 tokens 输入 8 美元、缓存输入 0.40 美元、输出 40 美元，Sol 为输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，均支持文本与图像输入、纯文本输出，上下文窗口约 105 万 tokens（另一第三方页面记为 1.1M）。
unconfirmed: 报道引用的成绩（Agents' Last Exam 最高 78.3%、Artificial Analysis 综合指数 62 分居第二、编程智能体榜仅 53 分且 Sol 倒退 3 分）、Astra 幻觉率从 50% 升至 59%、以及 Matt Shumer、Theo Browne、Ethan Mollick 等人的具体差评，均仅见于极客公园的转述或厂商自述，未经独立复测；发布前一天加州总检察长起诉 OpenAI、测试期间“至少 80 起安全事件”、Ultrafast 模式自 2027 年 3 月 1 日起由 3 倍涨至 6 倍、以及 GPT-6.2 尚未进入普通 ChatGPT 聊天界面等关键细节，同样只有单一来源或官方口径，缺乏独立核实。

titles.en: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with a 20% price cut, and developers push back
titles.zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，跑分领先但实测口碑分化
